text:
Maria (AE): FYI — NovaHealth POC brief: they want 10yr append-only audit logs, HSM-backed key storage, SOC2 + HIPAA. Asking for pricing and whether we can ship POC next Tue.
Samir (SE): Do we know expected log volume? 10yr pricing hinges on GB/month and whether they need hot search or cold archive.
Maria (AE): Early estimate: ~200GB/day ingestion during POC, long-term avg maybe 50GB/day. They need search for audits (so not pure cold). Region: eu-west-1.
Elaine (AM): Tagging deal-desk: long retention + hot search is expensive. We normally offer retention tiers: 90d, 1yr, 3yr (enterprise). 7yr and 10yr are special add-ons with pricing by TB-month + query ops.
Ben (Legal): From legal side: 10yr is fine, but we need explicit SOW + indemnities for regulated data. Also confirm export controls and data residency (EU-only) + DPA addendum for HIPAA.
Samir (SE): Technical notes for POC: can run with Redwood Private or Dedicated; both support HSM/BYOK. For HSM we support two modes: Redwood-managed HSM (HSM-Managed) or customer-managed keys in partner HSM (BYOK). Ops implications differ.
Maria (AE): They prefer Redwood-managed HSM to avoid on-prem key ops. Asked if HSM rotation every 90d is supported.
Samir (SE): We support rotation; if using BYOK there are additional onboarding steps. Also need to surface latency hit for envelope encryption on every write — small but measurable.
Elaine (AM): Pricing sketch for deal desk to review (ballpark):
- Compliance Logs Add-on (searchable): base 0–1TB retention included in Enterprise.
- Extended Retention tier: 7yr = $450 / TB-month (cold tier with search index warm), 10yr = $520 / TB-month (long-term cold + on-demand reindexing).
- HSM Key Management: Redwood-managed HSM = $6k / month + $0.015 per KMS op; BYOK onboarding = one-time $12k + $2k/month.
- Audit Export / eDiscovery queries: $0.03 per query-minute after 50 query-min/month included.
Elaine (AM): We can offer a 20% discount with a 12-month committed spend of $250k ARR; larger commits (>$750k ARR) unlock 35% off extended retention.
Ben (Legal): Need to add: SLA on log availability (we can commit to 99.5% availability of retrieval APIs for hot logs; archival restore SLA is 48–72 hours unless on dedicated warm storage). Must include data deletion/immutability model in SOW.
Maria (AE): Prospect asked whether audit logs can be exported to their S3 for cold storage while we serve search. They want dual-write.
Samir (SE): Yes — we can stream audit writes to customer S3 bucket (EU region), with server-side encryption (SSE-KMS). That reduces our storage burden but we still charge for indexing/search.
Maria (AE): I drafted a quick offer to send them. Can deal-desk confirm pricing and whether 10yr exception needs VP rev sign-off?
Elaine (AM): 10yr is an exception. For >7yr retention we require RevOps + Head of Sales approval + legal sign-off. I'll put a formal ask in the deal desk queue.
OpsBot: Deal desk request created: DD-8342 (owner: Elaine).
Ben (Legal): Also flag CCPA & EU GDPR: need to confirm retention justification and data subject deletion flows; for 10yr we should require written justification from the customer and a retention justification clause in SOW.
Maria (AE): For POC next week, they still want HSM in place. What's the fastest path?
Samir (SE): Fastest: dedicate a private deployment in eu-west-1 with Redwood-managed HSM. We can stand up a POC environment in ~5 business days if infra quota is OK. BYOK adds ~10 business days (onboarding + key exchange).
Elaine (AM): Recommend: run 2-week POC with 90d retention on our side but export to their S3 for the 10yr cold copy. During POC, validate search/retrieval and eDiscovery workflows, then convert to paid extended retention for final contract. This limits our risk while giving them what they need.
Maria (AE): Sounds good. I'll propose that to the customer and ask for volume confirmation and written justification for 10yr.
Ben (Legal): I'll draft the retention clause language and DPA addendum with HIPAA exhibits.
Samir (SE): For the deal desk entry, include the following sample SKUs in the quote JSON:```
{
  "sku_lines": [
    {"sku": "COMPLIANCE_LOGS_SEARCHABLE", "qty": "1", "unit_price": "$0 (base)"},
    {"sku": "EXT_RETENTION_10YR_TBMO", "qty": "X TB-months", "unit_price": "$520 / TB-month"},
    {"sku": "HSM_REDWOOD_MANAGED", "qty": "1", "unit_price": "$6000 / month"}
  ]
}
```
(Deal-desk should replace X with projected TB-months from their capacity estimate.)
Elaine (AM): I'll queue DD-8342 with the above pricing, note special approval path and requested discount band (20% conditional on 12m $250k commit).
Maria (AE): Thanks — I'll update NovaHealth and try to get a firm volume estimate today.
Samir (SE): If they accept the export-to-S3 + POC plan, engineering will prioritize automated export for the POC.
Maria (AE): Closing loop: can we get an expedite for infra quota? POC week is tight.
Elaine (AM): I'll ping infra and cc Samir. :rocket:
OpsBot: infra-quota request created: IQ-5591 (status: pending).
Maria (AE): Great — thanks everyone. I'll post customer confirmation when I have it.
__note: This thread contains short Slack-style messages. Field names are strings or list of strings per agents.md schema.
